name: Entrepreneurship and Small Business
description: How to start, finance and run a business of your own. ⚠⚠⚠ In Florida it is overwhelmingly a SHORT CERTIFICATE rather than a degree: 2,102 credentials across the two codes and 1,811 of them — 86% — are certificates of under a year. Only 144 bachelor's and 110 master's in the whole state system. ⚠⚠ Which is arguably the right shape, because the opportunity cost of four years is exactly what an intending founder cannot afford.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THIS IS A CERTIFICATE FIELD AND THAT IS PROBABLY CORRECT. Entrepreneurship/Entrepreneurial Studies (52.0701) produced 1,425 credentials at 28 Florida public institutions — 1,171 short certificates, 144 bachelor's, 110 master's. Small Business Administration/Management (52.0703) added 677 at 20 institutions — 640 short certificates and 37 associate degrees. ⚠ Valencia College alone awards 514 across the two codes, Broward 338, Seminole State 305. ⚠⚠ A cheap certificate taken alongside a job, or while a business is starting, is a sensible purchase. A four-year degree in entrepreneurship is a large opportunity cost for someone whose plan is to start something, and the credential itself persuades no customer, no landlord and no lender. ⚠⚠⚠ THE PREFIX CANNOT AGREE ON ITS OWN NUMBERS, WHICH SAYS SOMETHING. Florida carries Introduction to Entrepreneurship as ENT1000 at 11 institutions and ENT2000 at 7, with NO institution carrying both; and Small Business Management as SBM2000 at 14 and SBM1000 at 3, again with no overlap. ⚠ All four are lower division, so no baccalaureate credit is at risk — the cost is purely transfer matching, and the fix is to send the syllabus. ⚠ Note the one pair that is NOT a duplicate: USF carries both ENT3003 and ENT3004, which is good evidence those two are genuinely different courses rather than one subject filed twice.

cips.note: Entrepreneurship/Entrepreneurial Studies — 28 Florida public institutions and 1,425 credentials in 2023: ⚠ 1,171 certificates of twelve weeks to a year, 144 bachelor's, 110 master's. Valencia College 421, Broward College 338, Florida State 137, FSCJ 77, Indian River State 76, College of Central Florida 68.

Small Business Administration/Management — 20 Florida public institutions and 677 credentials: 640 short certificates and 37 associate degrees, and no bachelor's at all. Seminole State College 305, Valencia 93, FSCJ 90, Miami Dade 65.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The degree route, if a degree is what you want. General business is far more widely taught and far more portable — an entrepreneurship bachelor's is rare in Florida (144 a year) and signals less to an employer than a business degree does if the venture does not work out. ⚠ Take the entrepreneurship certificate alongside it rather than instead of it.

⚠⚠⚠ The single most useful adjacent subject, and the one most founders wish they had taken. Cash flow, not profit, is what closes small businesses, and the owner who can read their own books survives longer. ⚠ GEB4891 Strategic Planning is carried by 13 Florida institutions but accounting is carried by 32.

⚠ Named because customer acquisition is the actual constraint on most new businesses, not the idea. ⚠⚠ MAR2011 Principles of Marketing is carried by 24 Florida institutions, all state colleges — the same places that teach the entrepreneurship certificates, so the two stack cheaply.

⚠ Named for realism about where Florida's small businesses actually are: restaurants, bars, lodging and events are among the commonest things people start in this state, and they are also among the hardest to survive. ⚠⚠ The food-safety manager certification is a legal requirement for a licensed food establishment.

⚠ Named for the same reason: a licensed child care centre is a small business, and Florida requires its DIRECTOR to hold the Florida Director Credential. ⚠⚠ Where the business you intend to start is regulated, the operating credential matters far more than the entrepreneurship one.
